name: Another Power Source?
summary: In Gadgetzan, Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle offers you another power source for ten Wastewander Water Pouches.

sections.title: A Costly Replacement
sections.body: Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle believes the first power source ran out of time or was lost in the sand. Whatever happened, he has another one to sell you. Times are tough all around, so he asks for ten Wastewander Water Pouches.

faq.q: Why does Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle want Wastewander water pouches?
faq.answer: Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle asks for ten Wastewander Water Pouches in exchange for another power source. Times are tough all around.
Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle offers the exchange and has more power sources to sell.

faq.q: What happened prior to needing another power source?
faq.answer: This follows Slake That Thirst, when you first obtained a power source for your kit.
